estimates.assumptions: 250g dry udon noodles (standard package size for this recipe name); ~350 kcal/100g, 12g protein/100g
2 tbs = 30ml sesame oil; fully used in the stir-fry
1 medium onion (~110g) sliced; edible portion only
0.25 medium head cabbage (~250g edible portion after trimming)
10 medium shiitake mushrooms (~200g fresh whole weight; stems trimmed but included in estimate)
4 medium spring onions (~60g edible portion); half used in cooking, half sprinkled at end
4 tbsp = 60ml mirin; all added to sauce
2 tbs = 30ml soy sauce; all added to sauce
1 tblsp = 12g caster sugar; all added to sauce
1 tblsp = 15ml Worcestershire sauce; all added to sauce
